notes.title: Narvas in Early Access!
notes.content:
The story of Mace, a young scavenger recently promoted to the Resource Collection Department for the Narvas Colonies. He is ordered to infiltrate and discover resources on distant planets in search of materials to ensure the survival of his people. Supplies are hemorrhaging, scarce, and unaccounted for. Times are bleak for Narvas.

The scavenger feels the weight of an entire population on his shoulders as he embarks on increasingly more dangerous and deadlier missions. It is up to Mace and his mechanical companion Toby to discover the source behind the recent shortages and save an entire colony from extinction.

Take control of Mace in this local co-op side scrolling platform shooter as you go from assignment to assignment taking on enemy bots and dangerous bosses on different planets.

[url=Try the demo now on steam!]https://store.steampowered.com/app/640700/Narvas/[/url]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sprint, dodge, wall climb, and teleport through platforming situations.
[*] Take control of your personal bot, Toby, to help navigate through levels or use him to unleash a devastating attack.
[*] Collect gun mods and ability buffs that drop randomly to help you through your assignment.
[*] Track your fastest times for each level and compare your time to the best of Steam's Community.
[*] Single player or Local Co-op through any level.
[*] Replay any mission at any time in order to get the perfect run and fastest time.
[*] Build momentum from successful missions to increase your effectiveness for future levels.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=pGxAN2wLlIw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Join the discord! [url=]https://discord.gg/j9qH4Eg[/url]

notes.title: JIT Remake Beta! Read below to access!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The Just Ignore Them fix/remake is ready for beta testing! I have fixed the story to not only make more sense but to also give more depth and human personalities to the characters. I have also fixed a few bugs that I found along the way.

Anyone who has purchased the game and wishes to test the beta, please leave your feedback here in this announcement! I will be adding patches for this week only! As it will be prepared for porting next week. I will be also making some brand new music tracks to the game as it was a major complaint by the community.

please note that the beta is in ENGLISH ONLY! Other languages will just mess up the game. They will be re-translated once the game is out of beta stage.

HOW TO ACCESS THE REMAKE BETA

* Open the game's steam properties and navigate to betas.
* instert the password "justignorethem" and click check code
* from the drop down box select jit_remake_beta and wait for it to download and install


Then enjoy the new story for Just Ignore Them! Also, please leave as much feedback as you can along with any grammar/ spelling mistakes as well as bugs.

tags.bug: I have also fixed a few bugs that I found along the way.

notes.title: Game and Demo Updated! (Please Read!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

This is just a quick small update to both the game and the demo.

For the update to take effect, start a new game.

Update includes:

- The Game and Demo's moving and animation mechanics have been fixed to 
   look smooth and faster rather than slow and choppy.

- You can now skip the black screen text Cutscenes by pressing [Esc]

- A few grammatical errors have also been fixed.

Also, check out my next game if you liked Just Ignore Them. You can download the demo free here: [url]https://stranga.itch.io/owt[/url]

notes.title: Major Update 1 Released! Please Read!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have just implimented the first Major update for Just Ignore Them.

There have been some changes that I said would be in the update which are due to some translation errors that I am trying to work out. However, I have the first update live which does include the following:

[list]
    [*]Turkish Translation!
    [*]A new text editing system plus an overhaul on the grammar and spelling for the English translation.
    [*]Quick finish game glitch bug fixed!
    [*]Main Menu redesign for...y'know...extra stuff.
    [*]2 secret Items for Extra Content Update (Coming Soon!)
    [*]A few other bug fixes
[/list]

IF GAME SAVES ARE NOT WORKING SEE BELOW

Now, your current saves will no longer work BUT you can make them work by rolling back the version of the game by doing the following!

In your games library right clik Just Ignore Them and go to properties and go to betas. Use the dropdown box and go to rollback (No password needed). You will now be able to access your old saved games :).

[*]A new text editing system plus an overhaul on the grammar and spelling for the English translation.
[*]Main Menu redesign for...y'know...extra stuff.
[*]2 secret Items for Extra Content Update (Coming Soon!)

notes.title: Major Update Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
To everyone that currently owns the game, PLEASE READ!

This will be the first Major update for Just Ignore Them! This update will include an overhaul on a few things including spelling, grammar and bugs!

[b]NEW DIALOGUE EDITING SYSTEM[/b]

I have implimented a new system that will allow me to easily and quickly edit 
dialogue text without corrupting saves.

[b]NEW FEATURE[/b]

There will be a new extended story feature added. To access it, you must find 
the tape recorder in the game after the update.

[b]THE BAD NEWS[/b]

Unfortunately all previous save games will corrupt after the Major 
Update. This is due to the engine not being able to read new things that I've added to the game. HOWEVER, I will be making a 
"Rollback" Version which will be accessible in the steam settings which you'll be able to use your old saves.

I don't have an exact date for the update, but all the ground work and about 90% of the update is done. If you guys have any questions please post them here, I'd be happy to answer them :)

notes.title: Soundtrack is Now Avaliable!
notes.content:
[h1]Did You Enjoy The Music?[/h1]
If you enjoyed the soundtrack as much as the game, you know can purchase it to listen to whenever you like!

The Just Ignore Them Soundtrack was originally composed an created by me. I tried my best to really capture the moment in the scenes and to emphasize emotion in the music (As best as I could).

[h1]How to install/access the Soundtrack[/h1]
There's no installation process. Once purchased and downloaded, the soundtrack will show up in the games directory. The Soundtrack takes a little digging through the game's Steam Directory, which could be located in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Just Ignore Them

P.S This may not be the case for everyone, others directories may be different but it's in the [ \Steam\steamapps\common\Just Ignore Them ] folder

tags.feature: The Just Ignore Them Soundtrack was originally composed an created by me.
